semantic.justification: Browser ABI seed/result adapter reuses the byte-identical standalone Crc32 module from existing installed zip.js2.24.0. The complete original BSD notice is retained in third_party/zipjs-codecs/crc32.mjs and source.json records its exact package path/hash. Running register inversion bridges zlib finalized CRC seeds, including FFFFFFFF whose inverted zero cannot be passed through the library constructor || default. The public running register is initialized on the actual library class; no CRC algorithm or stand-in library provider is implemented. Node zlib independently checks results and actual upstream SAL CRC QA is ported. No download/new dependency or native/host-memory ownership emulator.
